units.rawText: Oh, if it isn't the Professor? Have you come to these hallowed grounds to confess? Or are you hiding from Persicaria and the Doll who just joined us?

spans.text: Oh, if it isn't the Professor? Have you come to these hallowed grounds to confess? Or are you hiding from Persicaria and the Doll who just joined us?

units.rawText: Uh... Neither of those. I'm just wandering around the Oasis, trying to stimulate my memory. How about you, Erika?

spans.text: Uh... Neither of those. I'm just wandering around the Oasis, trying to stimulate my memory. How about you, Erika?

units.rawText: If you're asking about my work... The Oasis doesn't have a prison, and the confessional is hardly ever used, so I've been spending my time studying the Sacred Canon.
units.displayText: If you're asking about my work... The Oasis doesn't have a prison, and the confessional is hardly ever used, so I've been spending my time studying the Sacred Canon.

spans.text: If you're asking about my work... The Oasis doesn't have a prison, and the confessional is hardly ever used, so I've been spending my time studying the Sacred Canon.

units.rawText: But I suppose that's not what you're asking. Don't worry—I'm no longer the Doll you first met, the one who lived only to seek a way to return to ashes.
units.displayText: But I suppose that's not what you're asking. Don't worry—I'm no longer the Doll you first met, the one who lived only to seek a way to return to ashes.

spans.text: But I suppose that's not what you're asking. Don't worry—I'm no longer the Doll you first met, the one who lived only to seek a way to return to ashes.

units.rawText: After every field operation, Dushevnaya and Abigail take me to the med bay for a neural cloud evaluation. You've also been checking on me regularly... It's hard to imagine falling unwell with such care.

units.rawText: Hehe, you've really changed compared to the time you first arrived at the Oasis, Erika.
units.displayText: Hehe, you've really changed compared to the time you first arrived at the Oasis, Erika.

spans.text: Hehe, you've really changed compared to the time you first arrived at the Oasis, Erika.

units.rawText: I'm no longer shackled by the filthy prison of my past, and I don't wish for my life to end anytime soon. So many care about me, whether it's you, Dushevnaya, or Abigail... Hmph, I have to admit, it's not a bad feeling.

units.rawText: But aside from that, I can't help but wonder—would you care to confess your relationships with certain Dolls, Professor?
